The handoff is written to `HANDOFF.md`. The short version:

**Root cause.** `dep-4471` turned on `gateway.pool.perRequest`. Every request now takes its own connection. The pool of 20 stays full.

**Impact.** Started `2026-03-14T02:14:18Z`. Still failing when the log ends at 03:59. 530 of 1228 requests failed.

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** Config generation `119 -> 118`. Flipping that one key back is enough.

The doc also flags that `/health` stayed green the whole time.
